typeText:
∀ {n : Nat} {g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Sized n g →
    ∀ (U : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} Nat Nat)) (i : Nat),
      LE.le.{0}
        (List.length.{0}
          (List.getD.{0}
            (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.layers
              (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.networkL g
                (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.canonIds (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g)))
              U)
            i List.nil.{0}))
        (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.nodeBound n)

source.code:
theorem layers_getD_length_le {n : ℕ} {g : GInstance} (hn : Sized n g) (U : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (i : ℕ) :
    (((g.networkL g.base.canonIds).layers U).getD i []).length ≤ nodeBound n := by
  have hNL := netNodes_length_le hn
  have hNL1 := netNodes_length_pos g
  rw [layers_eq]
  by_cases hi : i < (List.range ((g.networkL g.base.canonIds).nodes.length + 1)).length
  · rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simpa using hi), List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range]
    exact le_trans (layerState_front_le _ _ hNL1 _) hNL
  · rw [List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by simpa using hi)]; simp [nodeBound]
